subject: Request: Reassign committed APAC capacity to EU/US – timeline & SOW impact
messages:
From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@nebulacloud.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@nebulacloud.com
Date: 2026-11-21T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: shift committed APAC capacity to EU/US (NebulaCloud)

Hi Ben,

Quick note from product ops: our usage profile for the Helix pilot shifted significantly — APAC traffic dropped after the localization rollout, while EMEA and US spike ahead of customer launches. We have an existing dedicated commitment tied to NEB-8721 (committed tokens and a 4-GPU equivalent slab in APAC).

Can Redwood reassign 3 of those committed GPU-equivalents from APAC to EU (primary) and 1 to US (fallback) for the next 6 months?

Key asks: 
- Feasibility: can the committed capacity be reallocated regionally without breaking the existing reserved pricing?
- Timeline: how fast can we re-provision and get SLO parity?
- Contract impact: will this require an SOW amendment and what are the billing/prorate implications?

I attached a short demand sheet (Nebula_capacity_proposal.xlsx) with per-region token forecasts and the proposed redistribution. Happy to hop on a 30m call if helpful.

Thanks,
Sarah Nguyen
Head of Product Ops | NebulaCloud

Attachment: Nebula_capacity_proposal.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@nebulacloud.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-21T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: shift committed APAC capacity to EU/US (NebulaCloud)

Sarah — thanks for the clear breakdown and the spreadsheet, appreciate the quick heads-up.

High-level: we generally support reassigning reserved capacity between regions for enterprise customers, but there are three constraints to confirm: 1) hardware mix (A100 vs H100) and equivalent token capacity; 2) current tranche/commitment windows (proration rules); and 3) regional provisioning lead time for guaranteed latency SLOs.

Looping in Karthik (sales) and Irene (capacity ops) to validate the technical and billing side. Karthik — can you confirm whether NEB-8721's reserved discount can carry to a region swap or whether procurement needs a formal SOW amendment? Irene — can ops map the requested redistribution to available tranches and estimate lead time and any short-term burst options?

We should aim to: 1) get a feasibility note by EOD Wednesday, 2) propose an SOW amendment draft, and 3) if feasible, schedule a 30m technical sync with Nebula this week.

-ben
Ben Carter
Principal Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: shift committed APAC capacity to EU/US (NebulaCloud)

Folks — forwarding Nebula's ask and Ben's note. Summary/considerations from a deal/contract lens: 

- Current commitment: NEB-8721 = equivalent of 4x A100-slab reserved in APAC for 12 months (started 2026-02-01). They want to reassign 3 units -> EU, 1 unit -> US for a 6-month window starting asap.
- Financials: if we can keep committed discount intact, we need to validate whether the existing monthly committed spend equals or exceeds the price delta for targeted regions. If not, we either propose a top-up or a partner credit.
- Procurement redline: ops likely needs a simple SOW amendment (region mapping + effective date + billing prorate). Legal has historically accepted these as a one-page amendment for region swaps.
- Technical mapping: Irene, please map these 4 'units' to SKU/options we can provision regionally (e.g., 3x A100-equivalents in EU, or 2x H100 + 1x A100 for cost/perf). Also confirm whether we can service immediate demand via transient burst capacity (burst lanes) while permanent capacity is brought online.

Attached: draft SOW_amendment_draft.pdf (template) and a quick internal demand mapping I sketched.

Required by EOD Wednesday: 
1) Ops feasibility + earliest activation date + suggested SKU mapping
2) If billing shortfall exists, proposed commercial remedy (credit, short-term uplift)

If ops confirms feasibility, Ben — let's book a 30m with Nebula and include our solutions architect.

-karthik

Attachment: SOW_amendment_draft.pdf

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-23T15:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: shift committed APAC capacity to EU/US (NebulaCloud)

Thanks — validated with capacity planning + provisioning teams. High level: feasible with a staged plan. Details below.

Operational proposal (staged):
1) Short-term (T+72h): enable burst lanes in EU & US to meet immediate traffic (non-reserved, on-demand at slightly higher rate) while legal signs amendment. This addresses the launch window.
2) Mid-term (T+2–3 weeks): reassign 3x APAC reserved-units -> EU reserved slab. We recommend mapping to 2x H100 + 1x A100 (cost/latency tradeoff) to meet Nebula's high-throughput patterns.
3) T+3–6 weeks: add 1x A10g-equivalent in US as regional fallback for lower-latency east-coast traffic; this preserves overall committed compute but optimizes token economics.

Constraints/notes:
- Lead time: EU H100 capacity requires a 2–3 week provisioning window for reserved tranches (firm ETA dependent on datacenter availability).
- Billing: our billing team can prorate the committed discount across regions if the total committed monthly spend remains >= their committed baseline. If their EU H100 mapping increases list cost > committed spend, we will propose a smaller commercial uplift or a temporary Redwood credit to bridge the delta for the 6-month window.
- SOW amendment: Laura, please produce a 1-page amendment referencing NEB-8721, effective date (T+3 business days), and region mapping. Use SOW_amendment_draft.pdf as the base.

Action items: 
- Laura: Draft amendment + send to Karthik for commercial sign-off by 11/24 EOD.
- Karthik/Ben: Confirm whether Nebula will accept H100 mapping or prefer strict A100-equivalent units (I can map token equivalence either way).
- Ben: If Nebula approves, schedule 30m with their ops on 11/24 or 11/25.

Related docs: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_example_nebula_capacity (demand sheet + draft amendment). HubSpot: HS-984517.

Irene Choi
Director, Capacity Operations | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0123
